articleTitle: Bubble Sheet Multiple Choice Mobile Checker with Test Grader using Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: This paper describes a mobile phone-based system of image processing for automatically checking a student's bubble sheet paper using OMR sheet layout with high speed and precision. This mobile application is designed to aid teachers' workload for checking the exam and is a hassle-free mobile app that can be used anytime. Image processing, database, and user interface are the interconnected modules of the system. Python and the open CV library power the backend, while Android controls the frontend. The program was created using open-source technology, and there was no hardware necessary for the system to function. Using an image analysis technique that uses gradient extraction, the acquired image is processed, then transported, and the result is obtained using a mobile phone. Homography (ROI) surveyed the area of interest. Before data extraction begins, the background and foreground are corrected using image correction algorithms. Upon conducting the system analysis for its functionality, the researchers tested one hundred fifty-two sheets and obtained a total accuracy of 90.1% by checking the bubble sheets.

articleTitle: Design Method of Split Capacitance Value of ANPC Half Bridge Photovoltaic(PV) Submodule
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Cascaded H-bridge converter and modular multilevel converter (MMC) are suitable for large-scale photovoltaic (PV) grid connected system, because they can realize PV DC modular distributed access. In order to adapt to the 1500V PV voltage access and achieve electrical isolation, the PV sub-module adopts the DAB structure of active neutral point clamp (ANPC) half-bridge on the PV side and H-bridge on the output side. The split capacitor of ANPC side can buffer the high-frequency current generated by DAB modulation, and reduce the impact on PV voltage due to the interference of sub-module capacitor harmonic of grid connected converters on DAB transmission power. In this paper, the voltage fluctuations of PV and ANPC split capacitor are analyzed, and a design method of the split capacitance value is proposed. The proposed design method is validated using time-domain simulations via PSCAD/EMTDC on a 200kW PV submodule.

articleTitle: A Machine Vision Measurement Method for Large Plates Based on Reference Point Assistance
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In this work, a coordinate positioning method based on machine vision with reference point assistance is proposed to apply to the size measurement for large rectangular plate parts. This method first obtains the coordinate information of the reference point through circular detection, and uses the line detection and mean-shift clustering algorithm to fit the plate vertex information. Then the pixel coordinate relationship between the reference point and the plate vertex is used to solve the world coordinate of the plate vertex. Finally, the world coordinate of the plate vertex is used to calculate the length and width dimensions of the plate. Instead of other methods which unify coordinate system by moving cameras, this method uses reference point assistance system on measuring plate to unify the coordinate system, simplifying the difficulty of the unification of coordinate system and ensuring accuracy. Effectiveness of such method is verified by measuring rectangular plates with scales from centimeters to meters. The results showed that the measurement error could be controlled within 5 millimeters. In practical applications, the measurement accuracy has been much higher than the processing accuracy during the plate manufacturing, meeting the needs of size measurement.

articleTitle: CNN-LSTM combined prediction algorithm for transmission line loss rate based on improved SSA
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Line loss rate is an important indicator for evaluating the transmission level of transmission lines. In this paper, the SSA signal decomposition method is introduced. Aiming at the application of line loss rate decomposition, a local feature enhancement strategy based on sliding window is proposed. An agglomerative hierarchical clustering signal classification strategy is proposed to accurately classify trend segments, periodic segments and noise segments of line loss rates. On the basis of line loss rate feature extraction, this paper proposes a combined prediction of transmission line loss rate based on CNN-LSTM. The experimental results show that after using the EMD, WT and Sliding SSA signal decomposition methods, the prediction error indicators all decrease, and the signal decomposition is beneficial to improve the prediction accuracy of the subsequent prediction network. Sliding SSA has the best effect on the performance improvement of line loss rate prediction. Comparing the mainstream prediction network LSTM and Bi-LSTM, Bi-LSTM has a lower error index than LSTM under the same pre-decomposition method, while the error index of CNN-LSTM proposed in this paper is lower than that of Bi-LSTM, and the prediction effect of this algorithm is the best.

articleTitle: An Electromagnetic Generator for Self-powered Wireless Sensor Node on Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Transmission lines are susceptible to breeze vibration, threatening the operation of power grid. The self-powered system based on electromagnetic generator (EMG) provides an ideal method for online monitoring of various parameters of transmission lines and has the potential for large-scale deployment. This paper reports a miniature EMG having high energy output, with a volume of only 62 cm<sup>3</sup>. The vibration pickup unit in this generator has multimodal characteristics, which can harvest the vibration energy from arbitrary direction and multiple frequencies. The EMG uses two magnets coupled by winding coil to generate electricity. At 0.5g acceleration excitation along X-axis and Y-axis directions, the peak voltages of the EMG reach 1 and 0.8 V, respectively. While along Z-axis direction under the same acceleration excitation, the peak voltage and power of the EMG reaches as high as 2.4 V and 35.5 mW, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on X-ray Detection Technology for Connection Fittings of UHV Transmission Lines based on helicopter live work
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The traditional X-ray detection of the connection fittings of transmission lines is mainly carried out by manual tower climbing or unmanned aerial vehicle assistance, and is widely used on lines of 220kV and below. For the ultra-high voltage(UHV) multi-split conductor condition, it is difficult for the live worker to carry the X-ray detection device into the equipotential position and the efficiency is low. Aiming at the X-ray live detection operation of UHV line helicopters, this paper proposes an operation method to complete the whole process of X-ray detection under equipotentiality, develops an equipotential detection system, conducts the analysis of arc discharge interference when the suspended conductor enters the equipotential operation, and conducts Equivalent discharge interference test and field application. The results show that the developed helicopter X-ray live detection system can be applied to live work of AC 1000kV/DC ±1100kV and below transmission lines, and the practical application effect is good.

articleTitle: PV Prediction Using Hierarchical BiLSTM-RFR Model Considering Meteorological Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Prediction to the photovoltaic (PV) power is critical to maintain power balance and secure operation of power system. To improve the prediction accuracy, this paper newly proposes a hierarchical prediction model with the complementary empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD) by combining bidirectional long short-term memory neural network (BiLSTM) and the random forest regression (RFR). At first, the PV power is decomposed to several intrinsic modes using the CEEMD. Then by analyzing the correlation between intrinsic modes and meteorological factors with the Spearman correlation coefficient, the prediction model based on the BiLSTM and RFR is proposed for the strongly and weakly correlated components. Finally, the resultant components are combined to obtain the predicted PV power. The simulation results validate the prediction accuracy with the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on Compressed Slot Antenna Resonating at Higher Order Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Slot antennas are widely used on account of their small size, light weight, and low profile. In this research, a compressed slot antenna resonating at higher order modes is proposed. The center frequency of the antenna is 3 GHz and the designed slot length is 50mm. The change of compressibility is achieved by adjusting the dielectric substrate’s relative permittivity. According to the simulation results, the slot antenna operating at higher resonant modes performs better in terms of input impedance and directivity.

articleTitle: A Flexible Solar-blind Ultraviolet Photodetector Based on Carbon Dots
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: With the update and iteration of intelligent devices, there are more demands for flexible and foldable functions of devices. Therefore, flexible materials as substrates are a promising research direction for solar-blind ultraviolet (UV) photodetectors (PDs). At the same time, carbon dots (CDs) are also widely concerned due to their excellent optical performance. In this work, a flexible solar-blind UV PD based on CDs is fabricated on a low-cost using polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) and polyethylene terephthalate (PET) as substrates, respectively. Under the same fabrication and bending test conditions, the device based on PET substrate shows better performance, that is, it has more stable operating current and lower loss caused by bending. The device based on PET exhibits extraordinary detectivity of 1.76×10<sup>11</sup>Jones without bending and 1.68×10<sup>11</sup>Jones at the bending strain of 0.2% at 10V. The results show that flexible solar-blind UV PDs are of great significance for the realization of wearable functions.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Charging System Based on Bilateral LCC
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The soft switch of bilateral LCC wireless charging system is affected by network parameters. A topological parameter optimization method based on bilateral LCC wireless charging system is proposed in this paper. Equivalent circuit model of bilateral LCC wireless charging system were analyzed, and the expressions of output current and equivalent impedance are derived. Then, the changing trend of capacitor element parameters on system phase difference is studied, and the key method to optimize capacitance is given. Finally, an experimental prototype with a working frequency of 85KHz and an output power of 2KW is built for experiment to verify the effectiveness of the parameter optimization design scheme.

articleTitle: Study of Fuzzy PID Controller for EMA Optimized with Beetle Antennae Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: This paper introduced the design of a self-adaptive fuzzy PID motor controller and implemented beetle antennae search(BAS) algorithm combined with fuzzy logic for real-time online fine-tuning to optimize PID parameters. The study is dedicated to solving the problems caused by high non-linearity, thus meeting EMA systems' high dynamic characteristic requirement. A thorough MATLAB model of the EMA control system is set up to verify the algorithm's effectiveness. Compared to traditional PID controllers, the model proposed in this paper shows significant improvement in dynamic response, static response characteristics, and robustness. A similar result acquired with a full-scale hardware platform offers further proof of the method’s feasibility.

articleTitle: Ship Target Detection Framework Based on Non-Image Domain
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of efficient SAR detection of marine ship targets, this paper proposes a ship target detection processing framework based on non-image domain, which is divided into three parts: data generation, rough detection and fine detection. Composite scene data and real scene data are processed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Technical System and Evolution of Energy Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: With the development of digital technology and the acceleration of energy transformation process, the combination of advanced digital information technology and energy field will promote the intelligent transformation of energy system. Based on the development of digital technology, the technical system and evolution path of energy digitalization are studied in the paper. First, the development of digital technology in recent years is summarized. Second, the technical system of energy digitalization is analyzed, and the application mechanism of energy digitalization is studied. Third, the evolution of energy digitalization is analyzed. Finally, the development prospect of energy digitalization is put forward.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of the Controller for Novel 6-DOF Magnetic Suspension Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: To improve the speed of mass transfer, a novel magnetic suspension platform with ultra-precision, large stroke and high start/stop acceleration is designed. One of the innovations of this new magnetic suspension platform is there are three magnetic bearings. The model of the suspension force is established. The controller of the actuator is designed. To achieve stable suspension of the actuator, the characteristics of the controller were studied. And the Matlab/Simulink is used to build controller modules. The effect of s and m values on the stability of the system is investigated. To improve the anti-interference of the actuator. the PID algorithm is used, and the effect of different values of P, I, D on the control system is investigated. The optimal values of P, I, and D are obtained with the MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Research on Topology of Dual Arm Hybrid Direct Current Circuit Breaker and Its Control Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: High voltage Direct Current (HVDC) is more suitable for long distance and large capacity power transmission, which can effectively improve Grid-connected absorption capacity of distributed generation. DC circuit breaker, as the core equipment of HVDC, which can quickly cut off fault current and prevent faults current from expanding. DC circuit breakers are mainly divided into such three types as mechanical, solid, and hybrid, of which the hybrid DC circuit breaker has the advantages of strong carrying capacity, small loss, easy extinguishing of arc and fast cutting off the fault current and has gradually become the main development direction of DC circuit breaker. In this paper, by studying a typical hybrid DC circuit breaker, which has such disadvantages as large capacity of arrester, none zero-voltage opening of solid state switch set and long time of fault current removal, a hybrid double bridge hybrid DC circuit breaker is proposed. The two kinds of circuit breakers are compared by simulation, which proves that the dual-arm hybrid DC circuit breaker proposed in this paper is more economical, the fault current is cut off faster, and the solid-state switch group can realize Zero voltage switching (ZVS).

articleTitle: A Vertical Structured Solar-blind Ultraviolet Photodetector Based on Carbon Dots/Graphene
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Compared with infrared, solar-blind ultraviolet (UV) has the advantage of extremely low background noise, which is prospective in the field of photodetection. A vertical structure has attracted our attention due to the short channel length and the high carrier mobility. Meanwhile, carbon quantum dots (CDs) are a promising photosensitive layer material, while graphene shows excellent photoelectric properties after binding to CDs. This paper builds a vertical structured solar-blind UV PD, with graphene used as the transparent electrode, CDs film used as the photosensitive layer, and aluminum film used as the source and drain contacts. The device exhibits responsivity of 375.5 mA/W, normalized detectivity of 9.36×10<sup>8</sup> Jones and on/off ratio of 11.2 at -5V drain-source bias voltage and 0V gate voltage under the illumination of 1.5mW/cm<sup>2</sup> by 254 nm wavelength. The results show that our PD has excellent photoelectric performance.

articleTitle: Preparation and Pressure Sensitivity Extraction of Flexible MWCNT-PDMS Pressure Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Flexible composite conductive materials have been widely used in the products of electronic skin, smart wearable devices, medical rehabilitation, and other fields due to their good electrical sensitivity and mechanical tension properties. In this work, multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNT) were doped into Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) substrate to form piezoresistive microstructure, and the doping ratio was optimized. After the sample is prepared, its pressure sensitive property characterized by traditional resistance measurement is found to be much smaller than that of sensing materials. The decoration of sensitivity is proved to be induced by the high level of contact resistance. After applying the modified four-electrode method in the resistance measurement, the contact resistance and Schottky barrier introduced by the poor electrode contact are effectively eliminated, and the effective sensitivity of the sensing material reaches 0.038kPa<sup>-1</sup>, which can satisfy the demand of electronic skin, wearable devices and high-precision medical testing. In addition, the results of this work also indicate that the methods to restrain the contact resistance, such as embedded electrodes, polishing the contact surface, increasing the contact area, and the optimization of electrode materials, can significantly improve the sensitivity of the flexible pressure sensor.

articleTitle: Design of X-Band 6-Bit Wideband Logic Control Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: A X band 6bit phase shifter designed on 0.25 µm GaAs pHEMT process in this paper. In the design of 5.625° phase shift unit, the performance of VSWR(voltage standing wave ratio) and insertion loss of the circuit is improved by adding the interstage matching capacitor. At the same time, by changing the phase switching mode and increasing the order of the filter, a 180° phase-shifting unit is designed, which reduces the VSWR, insertion loss fluctuation and phase RMS (root mean square) error of the phase. By optimizing the cascade sequence, the overall performance of the circuit is improved. The simulation results show that the typical insertion loss is 8.5 dB, the voltage input/output standing wave ratio is less than 1.5, the phase RMS error is less than 1.4 in the operating bandwidth of 8-12 GHz. Overall chip area is 4mm * 1.8mm.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Influencing Factors of Electrical Preventive Test of Insulation Tools
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In order to standardize the electrical preventive test method and parameters of insulation tools, this paper took the insulation rod as an example to study the influence of different electrode structure, segment and whole segment withstand voltage on the electrical preventive test of insulation tools through simulation calculation, and put forward the revision suggestion of electrical preventive test method of insulation tools. Results show that the test electrode of 110kV voltage grade insulation rod should choose single wire or ring electrode, the test electrode of 220kV, 500kV and 1000kV voltage grade insulation rod should choose two-split, four-split and eight-split wire electrode. 110kV and 220kV voltage grade insulation rod is preferred to choose the whole segment test method, if the test conditions are limited, the segment test method can be chosen. If 110kV insulation rod adopts single wire electrode and the number of segment is 2 and 3, the segment coefficient is 1.27 and 1.66. If 220kV insulation rod adopts two-split wire electrode and the number of segment is 2 and 3, the segment coefficient is 1.21 and 1.49.

articleTitle: A Novel Discharge Electrode Structure to Increase the Times of Shockwaves Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) is an effective method to treat vascular calcification. IVL employs the shockwave generated by the electrohydraulic effect to make calcification fractured without damaging blood vessels. The current commonly used discharge structure is the wire-metal ring structure. However, with the increase in the number of discharges, the burning loss will continue to aggravate, leading to structural failure and seriously limiting the equipment's life at about 80 times. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes parallel wires discharge electrode structure for IVL. The changes of shockwave intensity generated by the electrode are measured with 1.6kV, pulse width of 60μs at PRF 1Hz. Then the gypsum ring is used as the phantom and the fracture ability of the shockwave on phantom is evaluated. The results show that the intensity and fracture ability of the shockwave remain stable over 280 consecutive generations. The discharge electrode can reduce the operation time caused by equipment replacement and relieve the pain of patients

articleTitle: Miniaturized Maxwell Fisheye Lens for Terahertz Multibeam Luneburg lens Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: A terahertz Luneburg lens based on Maxwell fisheye lens is proposed in this work. Benefitted from the features of Maxwell fisheye lens, we design the Luneburg lens by Maxwell fisheye lens as an intermediate structure. The idea of the feed moving away from the lens allows for more flexible feed design and reduces the design complexity of compact feeds in the terahertz band. The Maxwell fisheye lens is used to keep the feed antenna away from the Luneburg lens. Further, miniaturized Maxwell fisheye lens via transformation optics is presented for terahertz multibeam Luneburg lens. The simulated results have confirmed the feasibility of this idea successfully.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Non-contact Voltage Detector with Metal Cover for UHV DC
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of no mature and convenient voltage detector and method for UHV DC transmission line, this paper developed a kind of non-contact voltage detector for UHV DC transmission line with metal cover based on MEMS electric field sensor. This paper determined the voltage detection area of climbing the tower for UHV DC transmission line and the alarm threshold of voltage detector by means of simulation calculation and field tests, so as to realize the convenient and reliable voltage detection for UHV DC transmission line. Results show that the non-contact voltage detector developed in this paper adopts a rotating mechanism to control the opening and closing of metal cover to eliminate the influence of space charge on voltage detection. The alarm threshold of the voltage detector should be 15kV/m. Keep the metal cover closed before and after the voltage detection. During the voltage detection, the voltage detection personnel should be located at the tower body as the same height as the wire or the cross arm directly above the wire, and the insulation rod with the voltage detector installed at the end should be extended horizontally or vertically to aim at the wire, so that the distance between the voltage detector and the wire is 5~8m. Control the rotating mechanism to make the metal cover open can realize the accurate voltage detection.

articleTitle: High Performance Frequency Up-Conversion Energy Harvester Based on PZT Thick Film Technology for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology has greatly contributed to the development of smart cities, from smart homes to smart factories. The quality of human life is enriched by the comprehensive sensing and seamless communication of IoT devices in different spaces. As a foundation, wireless sensor networks, which currently consist of various fixed sensors, are experiencing sustainability and compatibility issues. Here, we report a broadband vibrational piezoelectric energy harvester (PEH) with frequency up-conversion (FUC) function, consisting of a high-frequency piezoelectric cantilever (HF-PC) with a resonant frequency of 214 Hz and a low-frequency stainless-steel cantilever (LF-SC) with a resonant frequency of 36 Hz, and the HF-PC is fabricated by MEMS PZT thick film technology. Under the excitation of external low-frequency vibration, the LF-SC at the bottom impinges on the HF-PC during its motion, and in this way converts the external low-frequency vibration into high-frequency piezoelectric cantilever vibration. The maximum output power of a single HF-PC is 521.5 ȝ: at 214 Hz and 1.0 g acceleration. On the other hand, the FUC-PEH is capable of achieving a maximum voltage output of 26.6 V over a drive frequency range of 26.2 Hz to 48.4 Hz, with an operating bandwidth of 22.2 Hz and a maximum output power of 775.3 μW. The output power is sufficient to power the Bluetooth temperature and humidity sensor, demonstrating the high power output and excellent charging capability of the FUC-PEH.

articleTitle: Performance Study of Flexible Solar-blind Ultraviolet Photodetector
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In recent years, solar-blind ultraviolet (UV) photodetectors have attracted more and more attention due to the strong resistance to background radiation interference and high detection sensitivity. However, most photodetectors are based on rigid substrates, which cannot be bent and folded. Flexible photodetectors have the advantages of being able to fit on surfaces of different shapes, which can reduce production costs and device volume. Meanwhile, carbon dots (CDs) have drawn great attention because of its high carrier mobility and excellent optoelectronic properties. The CDs solution was prepared by electrochemical method, which was uniformly distributed, with an average diameter of 2.5 nm and strong light absorption around 230 nm. The vertical structure is more advantageous than the previous horizontal structure. Since the channel length is determined by the thickness of the absorbing layer, it can be processed to the nanometer scale by spin-coating method, which is beneficial to improve the field-effect mobility and increase the leakage current. In this paper, a vertical structured flexible solar blind UV photodetector based on CD is introduced, which can reach more than 90% of the original current in the bending strain range of 0%-0.6%.

articleTitle: A Detection Method of Self Explosion Defect of Transmission Line Insulator Based on Cascade R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In this paper, a method for detecting the self explosion defect of transmission line insulator based on Cascade RCNN is proposed. This method is proposed to improve the accuracy of insulator defect detection based on deep learning. The ResNeXt101 network is used as the feature extraction network of this method. This method improves the generalization ability of the network. It reduces the number of super parameters without increasing the network parameters, and reduces the difficulty of network design and computational overhead. It improves the detection accuracy of the self explosion defect of transmission line insulator. This paper selects three common methods for comparison: Cascade RCNN detection method with ResNet101 as feature extraction network, Faster RCNN detection method with ResNeXt101 as feature extraction network and RetineNet detection method with ResNeXt101 as feature extraction network. Through experimental analysis, the proposed method has higher reliability, average accuracy and stronger generalization ability. It significantly improves the detection accuracy of self explosion defects of transmission line insulators.

articleTitle: Tree-trimming Device for 10kv Live-line Based on Conductor Car
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In order to solve problems of the high-risk and high-strength of tree-trimming on 10kV live-lines by man-power, a 10kv line tree-trimming device was designed based on the conductor car. Firstly, the overall structure and function requirements of the device are analyzed based on the characteristics of the line and tree branches; secondly, designed the traveling, braking, and shaft arm rotation mechanism of the device; finally, studied the arc current interference characteristics of the device during potential transfer, and proposed the electromagnetic protection of the device, and application was carried out on distribution line to verify the functions of the device. The results show that the device proposed in this paper can meet the actual demand.

articleTitle: Research on the Principle of Fast Amplitude Measurement Based on AC Surge Voltage Test
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The airborne equipment of civil aviation airliner has high requirements for rapid measurement of voltage transient process, and accurate AC voltage test is required. The common AC voltage RMS measurement method is mainly realized by the voltage transformer cooperating with the true RMS chip. However, if the compensation capacitance of the true RMS chip is larger, the transient overshoot of the power supply output voltage will be too large due to the delay; The capacitance value is small, the collected signal ripple is large, and the accuracy will be affected. In this paper, a method is proposed to quickly measure the amplitude of the angle between the sinusoidal AC two-point voltage and the phase. By sampling different phase amplitudes, the variable speed integration method is used to realize the fast and accurate response of the output voltage. The feasibility and practicability of this innovative principle are verified by the prototype test of design principle.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Power Definitions in Non-sinusoidal Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Non-linear loads are widely used in power systems nowadays. This application leads to affect the power grid negatively by producing harmful harmonics in the form of non-sinusoidal waveforms. Hence, the definitions of reactive power in non-sinusoidal have been proposed by various researchers who each of them claims that his proposed definition is proper to be applied to defined the power definitions in non-sinusoidal conditions and under the effect of harmonics. In this paper, most of power definitions in non-sinusoidal situations are reviewed and studied. Also, the point views of each researcher are discussed and compared in details. Finally, to examine the validation of the proposed power definitions in in non-sinusoidal conditions a case study was carried out by building a circuit under harmonic effects to measure the power parameters using experimental platform and Matlab environment to provide a numerical comparison of the power values measured based on those different definitions.

articleTitle: Energy Release Device for Solving Power Surplus Problem in LCC-VSC Hybrid Cascade Multi-terminal Transmission Project
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: LCC-VSC hybrid cascaded multi terminal HVDC transmission system has significant advantages in reducing multi-infeed DC commutation failure and improving multi terminal power supply reliability. However, the hybrid cascaded DC system has a significant problem: when the receiver system fails, the surplus power of the hybrid DC system will lead to overvoltage and overcurrent of the receiver VSC. Aiming at the power surplus problem of LCC-VSC hybrid cascaded multi terminal HVDC transmission system, this paper proposes a scheme of installing controllable arrester at the receiving end as the energy release device, and analyzes the characteristics of the energy release device under various fault conditions of the hybrid DC system, which is verified through PSCAD/EMTDC simulation.

articleTitle: A Cyber Security Monitoring Approach for Low-voltage Distributed Generation Control System Using Both Network Traffic Data and Side-channel Information
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: With the promotion of renewable energy generation, low-voltage distributed generation control system is widely applied nowadays, which also exposes more vulnerabilities to attacks due to its distributed nature and the fact that can be approached more easily, because it is close to the user side. Attackers launch their attacks through certain entry, for example, a communication device or a controlling device. Device been attacked will usually transfer malicious programs or commands to other devices belonging to the same system. In this paper, we proposed a method for cyber security monitoring in low-voltage distributed generation control system. This method can find out whether a terminal is transferring malicious programs or commands by analyzing its network traffic and side-channel information (power consumption). It is validated that proposed method is more comprehensive and accurate than traditional methods based only on network traffic analysis.

articleTitle: TomoSAR Imaging Method for Forested Areas Based on Blind Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar tomography (TomoSAR) extends the synthetic aperture principle into the elevation direction for 3D imaging. In TomoSAR imaging method based on compressed sensing (CS), the sparsity along the elevation direction is a necessary condition for reconstruction. Forested areas have complex electromagnetic scattering characteristics and we need to construct a dictionary to exploit the sparse representations. Due to the large differences along the elevation direction of different forested areas, it is hard to construct a general dictionary. In order to ensure the quality of reconstruction, it is necessary to construct a sparse representation dictionary adaptively according to different forested areas. For this reason, this paper proposes a novel TomoSAR imaging method based on blind compressed sensing (BCS). Compared with CS using fixed dictionaries, BCS exploits the sparsity in dictionaries that are learned directly from the data at hand and makes full use of the prior information of the data. Thus, more accurate reconstruction results can be achieved. To solve the model based on BCS, the variable splitting strategies are introduced into the imaging procedure. The experimental results show that it has higher reconstruction accuracy of the backscattering distribution of forested areas along the elevation direction than other traditional TomoSAR imaging methods.

articleTitle: A Review of Control Methods for Quadrotor UAVs
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In recent years, quadrotor UAVs have been widely used in civil and military fields for their excellent maneuverability, ability to take off and land vertically, and hovering flight. In order to solve the problems of underdriven, strongly coupled, highly nonlinearly, and easily disturbed quadrotor UAVs, many scholars have studied its control methods, which can be broadly classified into linear and nonlinear, and intelligent control methods. In this paper, we briefly review the published papers on quadrotor UAV control methods in recent years, classify these control methods into the above three categories, and briefly review each method.

articleTitle: Power IoT System Security Monitoring Based On Power Consumption Side Channel Information
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: With the widespread use of new technologies such as mobile Internet, cloud computing, and Internet of Things in power systems, the number of terminal devices in power systems has increased dramatically, and the ensuing security vulnerabilities have increased, making terminal devices increasingly vulnerable to cyber attacks such as ransomware viruses. In this paper, we focus on the security of terminal devices in power systems and realize security monitoring of power terminals by collecting power consumption side channel information of power terminal devices in normal and abnormal states, using training device abnormality identification models using supervised learning algorithms with some time-domain frequency-domain feature information of power consumption as power consumption features of the devices.

articleTitle: Study on Long-term Stability of the Ring Laser Gyro’s Scale Factor
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: To ensure that the scale factor is not affected by the power-on temperature and performance degradation during the long life of the laser gyro, to achieve the long-term stability of the scale factor, this paper has studied the theoretical and experimental aspects. First, the frequency stability theory and stability method of laser gyro are analyzed. Secondly, the temperature field distribution of the experimental gyroscope system is studied. Also, the effect of the stability cavity length and the power-on temperature on the scale factor is studied. Then, the reason for gyro performance degradation, which affects the stability of scale factor in long-term use, is analyzed, and the compensation method is presented. Finally, the experiments results are presented which prove the proposed method can ensure that the scale factor of laser gyro is not affected by poweron temperature and gyro performance degradation in long-term use and improve the stability of the scale factor.

articleTitle: Recognition for Radar Emitter Signals Based on Bispectral Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Radar radiator signal recognition is a key component of electronic reconnaissance system. In order to improve the accuracy of the signal recognition of low probability of interception(LPI) under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, this paper proposes an algorithm for feature extraction and recognition in the high-order spectral transform domain. This method overcomes the shortcomings of previous recognition algorithms that rely heavily on experience and cannot adapt to waveform changes. First, the bispectral transformation is used to form a three-dimensional physical representation of the radar signal. Then the bispectral diagonal slice of the radiation source signal is extracted. On this basis, Robust Principle Component Analysis (RPCA) is used to reduce the dimensionality of features. RPCA not only reduces redundancy but also reduces noise. Finally, LSSVM is used to analyze the feature vector to realize signal classification and recognition.

articleTitle: Active Power Imbalance of Regional Grids Including Uncertainty of Renewables and Grid Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The existing studies about power dispatch focus on power balance of whole system instead of each region. The long-term power balance of the regional grids is decided by different uncertainty. In this paper, the K-means algorithm is improved to reduce the scenarios of the wind and photovoltaic (PV) outputs. Two indices are newly defined to describe the regional imbalance, and quantified considering the stochastic wind/PV powers and random outage of the generation/transmission equipment. The generation re-dispatch model considering the imbalance degree is newly proposed. The sensitivity model of the objective function to the imbalance constraint is derived. The numerical results show that the proposed algorithm reduces the power imbalance of the regional grids. Variations of total imbalance degree of all regions are almost the same, independent of the scenarios. Increasing the upper limit of imbalance constraint reduces the objective, but possibly yields more load shedding under random outages.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Line Stereo Matching Based on Twin Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: For electric power visual technology in the construction process to ensure safe distance in the research, because the transmission line structure, special "sick area", using local information for three-dimensional matching speed is faster, but can not guarantee accuracy, especially the edge, occlusion, weak texture "sick area" has serious deficiencies, makes the transmission line identification and binocular vision three-dimensional matching task difficult. In order to ensure the accuracy of stereo matching and make more effective use of global information, this paper proposes a stereo matching algorithm of twin network combining segmentation results and fusion of geometric information, which can better stereo match such targets of transmission lines, and thus output depth images. In addition, there is a wide problem of empty pixels in the depth map. Introducing the depth smoothing function can better handle the position of the depth change in the depth map, and further improve the accuracy of three-dimensional matching. At the same time, the experimental results show that the depth map output of the proposed method is better accurate.

articleTitle: Close Contact Individual Monitoring Based on Prescribed Social Distance Using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Contact tracing is one of the methods used by the government and organizations for controlling viral diseases like COVID-19, which claimed many human lives. Social distancing is advised to everyone to minimize the virus from spreading. This study aims to build a contact tracing tool that monitors social distancing individually using computer vision in real-time. Object tracking by detection is used for individual monitoring with YOLOv4 (You Only Look Once) as the object detector and SORT (Simple Online and Real-time Tracking) as the object tracker. The combination gained an average streaming and detection frame rate of 26 FPS and 10 FPS on NVIDIA's GTX 1650, respectively. It is expected to have more frame rate when used in a more powerful device. Moreover, the system obtained 98.2% accuracy in measuring the distance between individuals. Furthermore, the performance of the QR scanner used in the study attains a 100% success rate and a 98% accuracy in allocating the QR code to the correct owner from the video stream.

articleTitle: Power Flow Calculation of Small Impedance Branches System Based on Improved Rectangular Coordinate Newton Method
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In order to solve the convergence problem of power flow calculation in power grid, an improved rectangular coordinate Newton method is proposed. This method improves the convergence of the power flow by modifying the Jacobian matrix elements of the rectangular coordinate Newton method. Based on the improved Newton method, a method combining the two is proposed to solve the power flow. The network with small impedance branches is took as an example, the simulation results show that the rectangular coordinate Newton method can’t make the ill-conditioned network converge, and the improved algorithm can make the ill-conditioned network converge. The combination of right-angle Newton method and its improved algorithm can also make the ill-conditioned network converge, and have better convergence than the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Power Flow Modeling and Voltage Imbalance Evaluation for Asymmetric Distribution Network with Single-Phase PV Integration
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In the distribution network with ungrounded neutral point or grounded via arc-extinguishing coil, asymmetric three-phase lines, loads, and distributed photovoltaic (PV), will cause neutral point voltage offset and changing the loads. The voltage magnitude of the neutral point is small and the range of the phase angle is large, which add the difficulty of power flow convergence. In this paper, the neutral voltage is newly included in the power flow model for three-phase unbalanced distribution network, where the loads are modified with the neutral voltage. To improve the convergence of power flow, an alternate solution to the power flow and the neutral-point voltage is proposed. The master-slave-splitting algorithm is applied to the transmission-distribution networks connected by the step-down transformer. The voltage imbalance index is defined. The proposed algorithm has good convergence, does not increase the computer memory, and is suitable for the voltage-sensitive asymmetric loads. The simulation applies IEEE 39-bus and IEEE 33-bus systems as the transmission/distribution systems by MATLAB

articleTitle: Efficient Sparse MIMO SAR Imaging with Fast Iterative Method Based on Back Projection and Approximated Observation
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Compressed sensing technique is widely used in the field of multiple input multiple output (MIMO) radar imaging to suppress sidelobes and noise, bringing better imaging performance. However, many constraints are introduced to the sparse reconstruction model, current sparse microwave imaging model is based on several assumptions, such as far field assumption, which might not hold in some circumstances. In this paper, a novel two-dimensional sparse reconstruction method based on approximated observation is proposed. First, we obtain the measurement matrix by the inverse back-projection operator, and construct a two-dimensional sparse reconstruction model. Then, we adopt the minimax concave constraint as the regularization term and use the iterative soft threshold algorithm (ISTA) for sparse reconstruction. The method retains the advantages of the BP algorithm and the sparse reconstruction algorithm at the same time, and the distance between the target and the antenna array is not constrained by image reconstruction performance of the sparse reconstruction algorithm. Simulations and experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Automated Crack Detection and Measurement Based on Mask R-CNN and Image Analysis with Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Early detection and analysis of concrete cracks allow preventive measures to be taken to prevent damage and possible failure of civil structures. However, previous methods of crack analysis require manual labor or costly equipment. Smartphones nowadays have high-quality cameras at an attainable price. This study is about developing an automated crack detection and measurement system with a mobile application for image acquisition. A smartphone camera is used to capture crack images, Mask R-CNN for concrete surface crack detection, and image processing to measure crack width and length. A total of one-hundred and fifty (150) images were tested. The system can successfully perform crack detection, crack measurement, and suggest crack condition if it is safe or unsafe. The system achieved 85% crack detection precision, ±0.15mm error on width measurement, and less than 10% relative error on length measurement.
